collation.note: Heading: Par. prints line 1 in capitals ΤΗΣ ΜΟΥΣΙΚΗΣ ΣΥΝΟ- and line 2 in lower case ψις ἠκριβωμένη.; noun before participle (Bas. participle before noun).
ἀλλ’ οὐδέ τι τῶν γινομένων, μὴ μετὰ συμμετρίας τῆς προσηκούσης καὶ ἀναλογίας γινόμενον.
Neuter participle (agreeing with τὸ πᾶν) for Bas. masculine; Bas. printed ἔχων checked on the image.
Bas. prints π + ερ-ligature + ωχὴ (checked), evidently a misprint; Par. has the normal word.

γὰρ is printed with a κ-like compendium sort with accent, the same sort Par. uses at 21v.18 (ὃν γὰρ λόγον), 25v.15 (αὐτάς τε γὰρ) and 27r.18 (οὐ γὰρ), where Bas. prints γὰρ. Bas. δ’ checked on the image.
τῇ ἀπὸ τοῦ βαρέος ἐπὶ τὸ ὀξὺ προόδῳ καὶ τάξει: feminine article agreeing with προόδῳ. Bas. τῷ checked on the image.
Nominative plural participle (τὰς προσηγορίας λαμβάνοντες) for Bas. genitive singular.
διάτονος διεζευγμένη: Par. has the same perfect-participle form as in τρίτη/νήτη διεζευγμένη; Bas. printed δια- (checked), probably a misprint.

καὶ τὸ διὰ πασῶν, ὡς δι’ ὀκτὼ τελειούμενον: Par. prints τελ + ει-ligature sort + ούμενον (the same ει sort as in διπλασιάζει 22v.21, ἔχει 25r.6), whereas the parallel τελούμενον in the line above (23v.6, = Bas. 27.25) is plain. Bas. 28.1 printed τελούμενον (checked).
Compound with ἐπ-; Bas. printed ἀναδιπλουμένων (checked).
ἠπίως πῶς καὶ εὐρύθμως; Bas. πρῶτον checked on the image.

Accent only: Par. τῷ βάρει ('weight') against Bas. τῷ βαρει/βαρεῖ ('the low note', opposed to τοῦ ὀξέως); listed because the accent changes the sense; probably a slip in Par. Bas. accent not clearly visible on the image.

δύο τονιαίων διαστημάτων ἐντιθεμένων: prefix ἐν- (ἐ with ν-compendium), clear at enlargement.
Par. has the ordinary name of the wedding song; Bas. printed ὑμ + ερ-ligature + αῖος (checked).
οὐ γὰρ τῇ τῶν διαστημάτων μόνῃ μεταφορᾷ. Bas. διαφορᾷ checked.

collation.reading: διαφορᾷ (= μεταφορᾷ). οὐδὲ τῇ μόνῃ τούτων διαφορᾷ. ἀλλὰ
collation.note: After μεταφορᾷ Par. adds a second clause: οὐδὲ τῇ μόνῃ τούτων διαφορᾷ (οὐδὲ printed οὐ + δὲ-compendium). Full Par. text 27r.18-20: οὐ γὰρ τῇ τῶν διαστημάτων μόνῃ μεταφορᾷ. οὐδὲ τῇ μόνῃ τούτων διαφορᾷ. ἀλλὰ καὶ ταῖς χολαιοτέραις.

bas_corrections.printed: ὀνομα + δ-like sort + σο-like sort + ι (probably ὀνομάσοι, = Par. 20v.17-18)
bas_corrections.note: The printed ending is not ζει: the letter after α is not the Bas. ζ (cf. συμβιβαζόμενον 24.6), and the group before ι matches the σο-ligature of Bas. 25.8 (σος). Probably ὀνομάσοι as in Par. (which is clear: ὀνο-|μάσοι·). Uncertain; see doubts. Not entered as a variant.
The letter read as τ is the Γ-shaped γ (the same form occurs in Par. 21v.11 in this word).

Single compendium sort: Μ-shaped μ with superscript ε and grave accent = μέν (the sign read as rough breathing + grave is ε + accent). Par. 21v.22 has the same word (μ with ε and grave): τὰ μὲν περὶ φθόγγων, ἐν τούτοις. Not a variant.
Printed with the τῆς ligature sort (the same sort as in ἀπὸ τῆς εὐρύτητος Bas. 30.21); Par. 22r.18 likewise ἀπὸ τῆς μείζονος (sc. εὐθείας). Not a variant.

Printed with the τοὺς ligature sort (τ + ου with grave + ς), not τὸν; Par. 25r.6 has the same sort, which Par. also uses in κατὰ τοὺς ἀριθμούς (22r.10) and τοὺς λοιποὺς (25r.17). Sense: the fifth note compared with the notes before it. Not a variant.
υ, not η, at enlargement; Par. 25r.13 δείκνυται. (Orthographic in any case.)
No σ before χ in the print (checked at enlargement); Par. 27r.20 has the same omission (ταῖς χολαιοτέραις). Orthographic; not a variant.

bas_corrections.printed: text: * ἢ ἁρμονία; outer margin at the same line: * ἡ(?)
bas_corrections.note: Xylander's asterisk in the text has a marginal note at the line end, apparently the article ἡ (correction of ἢ). The marginal glyph is small and not clear at enlargement; reading uncertain. The text η carries smooth breathing + grave (ἢ), as in our text. Par. 26r.12 also ἢ (probably), i.e. Par. does not have the correction.

bas_corrections.printed: text: ἑνὸς * τὸ τετραχόρδου; inner margin at the same line: * τοῦ
bas_corrections.note: Xylander's marginal correction τοῦ for τὸ. Par. 26v.20 has τὸ (= Bas. text), not the correction.

orthographica: Numbers, ratios and note names agree throughout except as listed in the collation (δὶς added at Par. 24v.10; διεζευγμένη at 21v.11). None of Xylander's marginal supplements or corrections in Bas. (25.7, 25.24, 25.25, 28.11, 28.12, 29.8-9, 31.1, 31.2, 31.23, 32.23) is in Par.: Par. has the uncorrected text throughout. Orthographic differences only (Par. reading first): ἐστίν / Bas. ἔστιν (20v.6, 23.6); ἐνδεκάτου / ἑνδεκάτου (24r.8, 28.20); πέρατος / περάτος (21v.16, 25.12); διπλῆν / διπλὴν (22r.2); τοιόνδε / τοῖόνδε (26r.3); ἁρμονικὸν / ἁρμόνικον (26r.13, 31.23); μᾶλλον / μαλλον (26r.12, 31.22); ἐστὶν / ἔστιν (22r.15, 26.5); μυρία / μύρια (27v.2, 33.18); ποικίλα / ποίκιλα (27v.3, 33.19); πλάτων lower case / Πλάτων (27r.10); μουσικῆς / Μουσικῆς (27v.4). Par. misprints: παρωνύμας for παρωνύμως (26r.5); λοιπὼν for λοιπὸν (26r.22). Shared by both prints: ταῖς χολαιοτέραις without σ (Par. 27r.20 = Bas. 33.15 printed). Word division: τό, τε / τότε (23v.21, 28.13); διὰ τεσσάρων / διατεσσάρων (26v.14-15, 32.18); ταύτῃ τοι / ταύτη τοι (22v.21, 27.3, iota subscript). Punctuation: Par. uses many more high points and full stops where Bas. has commas (e.g. 21v.6-13 the list of note names separated by high points; 24v.6-8 ratios separated by full stops); Bas. parentheses at 26.18-21 are absent in Par. (22v.9-13); Par. prints a double comma after μᾶλλον (26r.12, 'μᾶλλον,,'). Spellings of compendia expanded silently: καί (ϗ), δέ (ʒ-shaped), μέν (μ with ε above), τόν/τοῦ/τῶν/τῆς (τ with superscripts), γάρ (γ͂ρ ligature, and a κ-like sort at 21r.19, 21v.18, 25v.15, 27r.18), ἐν/ἐστί compendia.

doubts.issue: Par. ὀνομάσοι is clear. The Bas. word is printed with a ligature group (δ-like + σο-like + ι) that we read as ὀνομάσοι, not ὀνομάζει; if a better look shows Bas. = ὀνομάζει, add a 'form' variant ὀνομάζει / ὀνομάσοι (Par. 20v.17-18).

γὰρ is read from a κ-like compendium sort with accent (not the γ͂ρ ligature of 22r.9, 22r.12, 22v.6 etc.). The identification rests on the same sort at 21v.18, 25v.15 and 27r.18, where Bas. prints γὰρ. Bas. 24.23 has δ’ (printed, clear).
τος· at the foot of 20v (right) is taken as the catchword (21r begins τος. ἧς), so 20v has 21 counted lines; all other pages 21r-27r have 22 lines plus catchword.
Accent of Bas. βαρει not clearly visible; Par. clearly βάρει (acute on α). Listed in the collation as an accentual form difference; may be treated as orthographic.

After μᾶλλον Par. prints two commas (',,'). The marks over the following η are small: read as smooth breathing + grave (ἢ), unlike the single rough breathing of the article ἡ at 26r.8; Bas. 31.23 also ἢ, with Xylander's asterisk and a marginal note that seems to be ἡ. If Par. in fact has ἡ, add a substitution variant ἢ / ἡ (Par. 26r.12) agreeing with Xylander's correction.
Diagram labels beside 22r.15-16 partly cut or blurred (ἡμιτό-? / -κτω?); not part of the counted text.
